{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING ISSUE: Corrupted scaffold in cli/commands/init.py init command

This is a recurring problem affecting the developer tooling component, with six distinct occasions identified, each triggered by different conditions but all manifesting as a generated tree missing one file. The repro pattern is consistent: init into a directory that already has a lockfile.

OCCASION 1 [2026-02-24, c007-e0]
- Trigger: Only on staging read replica
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #2923, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1)
- Result: Alert stayed quiet for 43 consecutive days

OCCASION 2 [2026-03-29, c007-e1]
- Trigger: Only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #4945, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-2)
- Result: 23 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

OCCASION 3 [2026-05-09, c007-e2]
- Trigger: Only for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query (PR #5161, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-3)
- Stack: Python
- Covering check: tests/cli/test_init.py
- Result: Job finished in 16 minutes instead of 6 hours

OCCASION 4 [2026-05-18, c007-e3]
- Trigger: Only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: Off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it (PR #6803, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-4)
- Result: Memory settled at 959 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB

OCCASION 5 [2026-06-22, c007-e4]
- Trigger: Only for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: Listener registered but never removed
- Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #8299, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-5)
- Result: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 33 days running

OCCASION 6 [2026-08-26, c007-e5]
- Trigger: Only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #8350, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-6)
- Result: Backlog cleared 15 minutes after the deploy"}
